method.data_source: fresh read-only S3 list + ranged first-feature read of every served qc-zonage collection (nested-when-present); zone_source_level / zone_source_url / feature-level v2 proof extracted from the (uniform) first feature. NOT a full-geometry download.
method.portfolio_artifact_checked: zone-provenance-quality-matrix-20260803T001639Z-81de8d776a7d73c9.json (used for cross-check; lacks per-slug zone_source_url so a fresh scan was required to split UPGRADABLE vs NO-URL)
method.v2_proof_predicate: acquisition/src/lib/zonage-proof.ts featureHasV2Proof (proof.geometry_source with sha256:<64hex> + ISO retrieved_at)
method.level_vocabulary: historical-verified | documented | legacy-traceable | candidate | orphan | unknown (ZONE_SOURCE_LEVELS)

bucket_definitions.PROVEN: zone_source_level in {documented, historical-verified} AND feature carries a v2 proof
bucket_definitions.UPGRADABLE: zone_source_level in {candidate, orphan, legacy-traceable, unknown} AND zone_source_url is a real http(s) URL AND no v2 proof — candidate->documented target via source-identity capture
bucket_definitions.NO-URL: unproven level AND zone_source_url is null — not upgradable without discovering a new source
bucket_definitions.DECLARED-DOC-NO-V2: level says documented/historical-verified but NO v2 proof block (provenance-declared, not byte-captured) — neither PROVEN nor in the upgradable level set

net_new_vs_campaign.campaign_set_note: broad union of all vnatif + v2mass campaign artifacts in work/coverage (superset of the ~52 coverage-bound handled); used to be conservative (maximises overlap, minimises net-new claim)

caveats: UPGRADABLE counts PRESENCE of a real http(s) zone_source_url, NOT verified liveness. A per-URL liveness sweep (acquisition/src/zones-served-proof-url-liveness-sweep.ts style) is the next refinement to confirm which are still capturable now.

Endpoint classes are pattern-based on the URL. arcgis-rest (goAzimut, altusquebec, victoriaville, services*.arcgis.com) and geoserver-wfs (geocentralis /geoserver/ows) are geometry endpoints in principle; empirical automatability is NOT guaranteed (prior lane verdicts found several platform sources non-automatable: MapServer without geojson export, access controls, layer-identity mismatch). Treat the source_identity_capturable_estimate as an UPPER BOUND on the source-identity yield.
The 6 pdf-plan URLs are real http URLs but require georeference, not the source-identity method; excluded from the source-identity estimate.
zone_source_level / zone_source_url read from the FIRST feature; the write gates enforce uniformity across features, so the first feature is authoritative.

DECLARED-DOC-NO-V2 (28) are declared documented/historical-verified without a v2 proof block; they are provenance-declared, not byte-captured, and sit outside both PROVEN and the upgradable level set.
873 served collections vs 1106 catalogue: ~233 have no served collection (unserved) and are outside 'served zones' scope.
